skill1: Perfect Maid: Gain debuff immunity to 1 debuff(s), stacking up to 1 time(s) continuously.
skill2: Perfect Maid: Gain debuff immunity to 1 debuff(s), stacking up to 1 time(s) continuously.

caveats: ⚑ skill1 ATK buff trigger: kit says 'Activates when own HP falls below 90%'. The sim models no HP pool and the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so the literal trigger NEVER fires. Modeled as `passive` with the 5s duration retained as a placeholder — this is an UNMEASURED uptime assumption and is the single largest source of error in this override. If the real uptime is intermittent, this over-credits the team's ATK for the whole fight.
⚑ skill2 hitCount 120: 'normal attack(s)' read as ROUNDS fired by ade (1/pull, AR ammo 60), so the trigger lands roughly every two magazines. Not verified against a popup/buff-apply cadence.

⚑ Both Max HP grants use casterMaxHpPct ('of the skill user's Max HP'). Per the e3 rule ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct, so these are offensively INERT at scope lock; kept for kit completeness and any future HP-scaling consumer.
⚑ Burst keyed to burstCast (her own Burst II cast), not fullBurstEnter. If the buff is observed on rotations where ade does NOT burst, this is wrong and under-credits.
skill2's 420-normal-attack Perfect Maid line is unmodeled (debuff immunity, no damage path and no schema kind). At AR cadence 420 rounds is reached late in a 180s fight, if at all.
FB-by-timing left default ON for all buffs; noFb not set (measured-only). noRange not set (engine-automatic).
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. ade is a Wind/AR/Supporter Burst II whose entire damage contribution to a team is buff-side: two casterAtkPct grants (5.19% skill1, 10.15% burst) and two casterMaxHpPct grants (15.62% skill2, 25.15% burst), all targeting all allies. The two Perfect Maid debuff-immunity lines are defensive utility with no schema representation and no damage path — recorded verbatim in `unmodeled`. The load-bearing uncertainty is skill1's HP-threshold trigger, which cannot fire in a sim with no HP pool against a partless boss that deals no damage; it is modeled as an always-on passive, which is an UPTIME ASSUMPTION, not a reading of the kit. Treat the skill1 ATK contribution as an upper bound until a recording shows the real uptime.
